```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'Parameter Entity Value'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY general "&ent; Expanded">
  <?pi-target processing instruction data?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/sub" sub:attr="value">
  <!-- Top-level comment before CDATA and processing instructions -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text containing <tags>, &entities; inside.
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&general;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book)*>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, desc)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT desc (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "Jane Doe">
  <!ENTITY % extDTD SYSTEM "external.ent">
  %extDTD;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY cover SYSTEM "cover.png" NDATA png>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Catalog comment block -->
  <?catalog-pi status="active"?>
  <book xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="#book1">
    <title>XML Parsing &author;</title>
    <desc>
      <![CDATA[
        Description with CDATA section & unparsed entities notation.
      ]]>
    </desc>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)+>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value 1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; Value 2">
  <!ENTITY % macro "<!ENTITY e3 '&e2; Value 3'>">
  %macro;
  <?target-pi data="test"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://www.example.com/doc" xmlns:m="http://www.example.com/meta">
  <!-- Comment 1: Before section elements -->
  <section m:role="primary">
    <?m:pi-inside-element action="process"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with markup: <section>data</section> &e3;
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>&e3;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY ent-mid "&ent-base;MidEntity">
  <!ENTITY ent-top "&ent-mid;TopEntity">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY note SYSTEM "notes.txt" NDATA txt>
  <?archive-meta version="2.0"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="urn:archive:xml" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="urn:archive:xml archive.xsd">
  <!-- Comment explaining the archive contents -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="archive.css"?>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Complex CDATA with nested structures and entity references &ent-top;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&ent-top;</item>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local.ent "<!ENTITY stock-code 'CODE-999'>">
  %local.ent;
  <!ENTITY standard-stock "&stock-code;-DEFAULT">
  <?inventory-control mode="strict"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:inv="http://inventory.org/ns/details">
  <!-- Detailed inventory comment block with rich metadata -->
  <?inv:log level="debug"?>
  <stock inv:id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw inventory logs: [INFO] checking stock &standard-stock;
    ]]>
  </stock>
  <stock inv:id="s2">&standard-stock;</stock>
</inventory>
```
